profile.name: Twills
bio: I lead Mōchirīī for players across Asia Pacific, with a focus on recruitment, event coordination, member progression & dependable moderation.
My priorities are accurate schedules, useful build guidance, clear guild standards & leadership that follows through on member concerns.
Contact me by email, Discord or in game for recruitment questions, event support, disputes or an issue that needs guild leadership.
The jade seal and occasional cupcake detail give Mōchirīī its character; helping members improve and participate is the purpose behind it.
